svg.title: Power input and ARM stage

text.tspan: Power input and ARM stage with series relay · schematic (PROPOSED)
Two independent switches in series (Q2 and relay K1), each with its own firmware enable, its own optocoupler and its own pole of the ARM switch. The 12 V outputs are live only when both close.
J1+ 12 V IN (bench supply or battery, 16 V max)
DNP: use when the Pico runs from the 12 V supply instead of USB
Load returns go to J1− / GND_P (heavy trace).
The ignition-coil primary pulse current returns
there too: keep it away from the logic ground.
Pico 2 W and everything on the measurement side share GND_L.
The coil under test (CH-R2, CH-PU) is on this side.
Power: USB, or the optional isolated 5 V module (left, DNP).
• Both enables stay low until the self-test has passed.
• Arm: close the relay first (RLY_EN), then Q2 (PWR_EN).
Disarm: Q2 first, then the relay. The relay never
• While armed the Pico watchdog is on: a hang or reset
drops GP0 and GP22 (pull-downs) and both open.
• MID_SENSE live while Q2 is off = Q2 shorted.
ARM_SENSE live while both are off = relay welded.
Either one: alarm, tell the user to switch off J1.
• Switch 1 (Q2) is on only when PWR_EN, SW1A and SW2A all agree. Switch 2 (K1) is on only when RLY_EN, SW1B and SW2B all agree. Q2 gate:
12 V × 2.2 / 12.2, Vgs ≈ −9.8 V. Q3 gate: about 11.7 V through the optocoupler.
• SW1 is a DPST toggle (two poles), SW2 an E-STOP with two normally-closed contacts (or a jumper per pole). One fault cannot defeat both paths.
• Q1 / Q2 are P-channel MOSFETs (IRF4905, −55 V, 20 mΩ), Q2 with its source on the input side. K1: 12 V coil, SPST-NO, 10 A contacts (check part).
• Limits: input 16 V max (D1 clamps spikes), F1 5 A (rule 6 in docs/safety.md), F2 2 A per output. Use the bench supply current limit as well.
• R_BL discharges the rail when disarmed. PC817 transistor Vce rating (35 V) is above the drive voltages (≤ 16 V).
⚠ This board carries no high voltage
The 12 V rail only powers the CDI input and the trigger drivers.
The CDI makes the 200–400 V itself, and the ignition coil makes the kV.
Never bypass SW1, SW2 or the relay. Fire the CDI only into a load
(ignition coil + spark gap in a closed box). See docs/safety.md.
